claim_boundary_if_authorized.allowed: Schedule ratings rank upcoming defensive matchups from relatively easier to relatively harder using LOG-SAPA ordinal information.
prohibited: validated predictive edge beyond tested ordinal claim
claim_boundary_if_authorized.required_disclaimer: They are contextual rankings only; they are not point projections and do not change player value.

coverage.later_horizon_missingness: report all expected and covered rows by position and exact h; never silently drop

future_target_mapping.bye_handling: byes create no target row; horizon counts played games
future_target_mapping.eligible_target_games: played regular-season games strictly after origin cutoff and schedule-labeled no later than Week 17
future_target_mapping.horizon_index: h=1 next played game; h=2 second; h=3 third; h>=4 fourth or later
future_target_mapping.target: actual target-game team-position Half-PPR points minus offense baseline frozen at origin
future_target_mapping.team_future_game_order: order by actual kickoff then game_id

information_cutoff.history_candidate_rule: scheduled week in [max(1,W-10),W-1] AND actual kickoff strictly earlier than origin cutoff
information_cutoff.origin_cutoff: earliest actual kickoff timestamp among regular-season games schedule-labeled Week W

next_stage.first_eligible_origin: 2026 Week 5 if snapshot frozen before cutoff
next_stage.name: B34 weekly prospective snapshot freezer

ordinal_analysis.tie_break: defense team code, offense team code, target game_id
ordinal_analysis.tier_rule: within each group sort hard-to-easy and split deterministically into three count-balanced contiguous tiers; remainder rows allocated Hard then Neutral then Easy

origin_snapshot_construction.defense_effect: frozen LOG-SAPA-V1 defense effect from the same eligible pre-origin history
origin_snapshot_construction.future_game_baseline: offense baseline frozen at origin; never update for prospective target residual
origin_snapshot_construction.future_game_predictor: target opponent defense_effect frozen at origin; never recompute after origin cutoff
origin_snapshot_construction.offense_baseline: unweighted mean team-position Half-PPR points over eligible pre-origin history; minimum 2 games

per_position_display_rule.position_eligible_only_if: that position's mean h=1 within-origin-week Spearman point estimate is strictly >0

primary_statistic.permutation_null: within each analysis group independently permute frozen defense_effect assignments across target rows
primary_statistic.pooling: mean group Spearman within position, then equal-weight mean across QB/RB/WR/TE

after_H_GE_4_pass: Rest-of-Season ordinal schedule view through Week 17
Fantasy Playoff ordinal schedule view for Weeks 15-17

prospective_origin_contract.if_fewer_than_10_eligible_2026_origins: continue into 2027 under unchanged rules; never lower the 10-origin minimum
prospective_origin_contract.missed_origin_rule: a snapshot not committed before first actual kickoff is permanently ineligible and cannot be reconstructed or backfilled
prospective_origin_contract.primary_origins_selection_rule: first 10 chronologically eligible origin weeks whose snapshot is frozen before that week's first actual NFL kickoff

H1_SINGLE_GAME.if_fail: STOP ordinal production path; later horizon gates not tested for authorization
H1_SINGLE_GAME.if_pass_authorizes: single-matchup ordinal display consideration only; not automatic deployment

H2_3_NEXT_THREE.if_fail: Next-3, ROS, Playoff remain unauthorized; H_GE_4 not tested for authorization

H_GE_4_LONG_HORIZON.if_pass_authorizes: ROS and Fantasy Playoff ordinal display consideration only
H_GE_4_LONG_HORIZON.rows: all exact horizon groups h>=4 through Week 17

tier_co_requirement.calculation: calculate Hard/Neutral/Easy mean residual within group; average groups within position, then equal-weight positions
